node.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
node.reading:
Where Human Intelligence Debt and the Attribution Gap arrive at the same place — offered as an observation, not a proof.

Document Status — Field Note · Series: The Attribution Gap and Capability Loss Tegrity.AI · The Integral Management Society

This bridges two independently developed lines of work: the Human Intelligence Debt series — an account of why automatable human work persists, rooted in the scarcity of governance decision capacity — and the Attribution Gap theory — an account of why firms destroy the capabilities they most depend on, rooted in the divergence between contribution and credit. The two were not built to meet. This note records where they do, keeps each theory’s formal machinery in its own house, and is deliberately modest about what the meeting proves. The convergence is offered as something worth attention — a coincidence between two roads — not as evidence for either theory. The case for that restraint is the last section, and it is the point of the note.

relations: An anti-circularity design would separate evidence of technical contribution from evidence of organizational recognition.
No es una validación del Attribution Gap ni una reevaluación de resultados del cliente. El protocolo exige fiabilidad y control de sesgo antes de causalidad.
The invisible-talent account could motivate a blinded recognition study while retaining a different unit of analysis from the Attribution Gap protocol.
Es una adaptación de diseño, no una aplicación directa del protocolo application-capability ni una explicación completa de sesgo de contratación.
A useful capability-loss study must include retirements that genuinely remove redundancy as well as those that destroy value.
No toda aplicación local es un diamante ni toda centralización destruye valor. El protocolo requiere definición independiente de capacidad y resultado.
Diamond Inside opportunities can be described more precisely by separating technical contribution, current recognition and the route through which value might actually be realized.
El protocolo de atribución no es una tasación financiera ni demuestra que el valor potencial se haya realizado.
A safe search-pruning rule does not justify treating low usage or recognition as evidence that a business capability is dispensable.
Las unidades y propiedades matemáticas son distintas; no trasladar la antimonotonía del algoritmo al valor empresarial.
A capability-loss study should include useful survivors, genuine redundancies and documented losses rather than selecting only successful informal adaptations.
El relato de supervivencia puede tener sesgo de selección; no estima por sí solo frecuencia o causalidad del Attribution Gap.
Lineage establishes dependency, while contribution still requires independently evidenced consequences, substitution conditions and a reliable scoring protocol.
No confundir dependencia técnica con valor económico absoluto ni el estimador ordinal con una tasación financiera.
Independent dependency and attribution records provide a concrete comparison for the distinction between found flow and declared representation.
Los logs también son parciales e instrumentales. La separación reduce circularidad, pero no convierte la traza técnica en verdad neutral ni prueba toda Informational Friction.
The cost of obtaining clarity and the contribution of the capability being examined require separate measures and independent interpretations.
No usar resistencia a una entrevista, coste de mapeo o miedo a apagar como sustitutos de valor probado.
The information model can preserve separate dependency and attribution channels, allowing the Attribution Gap protocol to test their divergence without building it into the data.
El equipo que construye el modelo no se convierte por ello en evaluador independiente de su contribución.
Tacit-knowledge concentration can inform a contribution estimate when tied to observable exception handling and replacement conditions rather than reputation.
Dependencia de una persona no es automáticamente capacidad que conviene perpetuar; puede revelar fragilidad y necesidad de transmisión.
The stated Level 3 position is a methodological self-assessment, which should remain separate from certification and independently measured intervention performance.
El protocolo Attribution no certifica madurez de equipos; aporta una comparación de diseño de evidencia, no una homologación.

Work-based talent recognition illustrates why visible credentials and demonstrated capability should be assessed separately, while retaining a different unit of analysis from application-level attribution.
Personas y pares aplicación–capacidad no son unidades intercambiables. El relato no demuestra validez de un método universal de selección.
The independent occupancy channel illustrates the measurement discipline behind separating operational evidence from strategically asserted claims, while retaining each instrument's error model.
Independencia respecto del conductor no significa ausencia de sesgo ni valida por sí sola una estimación económica de contribución.
A cross-border follow-up should establish whether the same capability was retained, transferred, duplicated or lost before applying an attribution-gap explanation.
El protocolo empresarial requiere adaptación a dos entidades; no se pueden normalizar sus presupuestos como una única cuota de crédito.
The activation study should be assembled before outcomes are known, retaining failed reorganizations and absolute capability benchmarks rather than selecting only impressive survivors.
Es adaptación del diseño de estudio; el protocolo de atribución no establece por sí solo el benchmark de activación.
The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.
Aplicación propuesta; el protocolo no se ha validado aquí para comunidades de frontera ni se asignan puntuaciones a personas.
Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.
Traslado metodológico; el cálculo del toy no acredita validez de un instrumento de atribución humana.
Attribution measures should preserve their separate dimensions; improvement in one coordinate does not automatically compensate for an unmeasured or worsening coordinate elsewhere.
La nota es correctiva y no canónica; no se impone una función universal de bienestar o valoración empresarial.

compara el uso de registros de procedencia
El protocolo del Attribution Gap pregunta cómo atribuir contribuciones que una medida agregada puede ocultar. 00J pregunta qué derecho o decisión autoriza un registro específico.
